flags.message: The frozen band `elevated` (distribution_count 2) reads a call-for-response redistribution as a relist: the petition was distributed for the 4/17/2026 conference, the Court requested a response on 4/13/2026 before that conference, and it was redistributed on 7/29/2026 for 9/28/2026. It has not yet been considered at any conference, so its state is closer to a first-conference petition with a requested response than to the once-relisted population the elevated risk-set rate describes. Recorded so the evaluator can read the anchor accordingly; I forecast from the call-for-response state and anchored on the band table as instructed.
